approach:
# Attempt: extend CKgP / gonality stratification to M_{8,1}

## Selected case and goal

Work exclusively with the open pure-weight base case (g,n,k)=(8,1,16) appearing in RED-0001. Coefficients are Q throughout; all spaces are Deligne–Mumford stacks (never coarse spaces). The target pure-weight input for the degree-16 induction is the pure Borel–Moore piece

W_{-16} H^{BM}_{16}(M_{8,1}; Q)

(equivalently, via duality, the pure weight-graded piece of compactly supported / open cohomology of M_{8,1}). The aim of this single approach is to obtain CKgP for M_{8,1} by a gonality filtration, then apply the open-cycle-class surjectivity of SRC-0002 Lemma 4.3 so that pure weight pieces of even degree are algebraic and pure Hodge–Tate, discharging the (8,1) entry of RED-0001.

## Why (8,1) is forced by the published induction

SRC-0002 equation (6.1) gives the right-exact reduction

H_k(∂̂ M̄_{g,n}) → H_k(M̄_{g,n}) → W_{-k} H^{BM}_k(M_{g,n}) → 0.

For g≥1 and n=0 or 1, Borel–Moore vanishing (SRC-0002, citing [4, Prop. 2.1]) yields H^{BM}_k(M_{g,n})=0 whenever k<2g. At k=16 and n=1 this forces potential nonvanishing only for g≤8. For g≤7 and n≤c(g), SRC-0002 Table 1 / Proposition 4.5 already give CKgP and W_•H^•=RH^•, so pure weight is tautological. Genus 8 is absent from Table 1 (c(g) is recorded only through g=7: c(3)=11,…,c(7)=3). Thus M_{8,1} is a genuine missing base case for extending the k=14 argument to k=16; it is not covered by the published CKgP table, by genus-1 even tautologicality, or by the genus-2 degree-≤20 results.

## Strategy: gonality filtration of the open stack M_{8,1}

Filter by gonality (maximal Brill–Noether gonality of a genus-8 curve is 5):

M^2_{8,1} ⊂ M^3_{8,1} ⊂ M^4_{8,1} ⊂ M^5_{8,1} = M_{8,1}.

By SRC-0002 Proposition 4.2(3), CKgP of each locally closed difference M^d_{8,1} \ M^{d-1}_{8,1} implies CKgP of the union. Combined with open inheritance (Prop. 4.2(1)) this yields CKgP for M_{8,1}. If additionally pure-weight classes are algebraic (Lemma 4.3), even pure weight is pure Hodge–Tate; for the induction one needs the BM pure piece W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16} to be a sum of Tate motives Q(8) (pure Tate is strictly weaker than full tautological generation of all of H^*(M̄_{8,1})).

### Step A — Hyperelliptic and trigonal strata (published)

SRC-0004 Lemma 9.9: for g≥4 and n≤g+7, the trigonal locus M^3_{g,n} has the CKgP and all classes supported on M^3_{g,n} are tautological. For (g,n)=(8,1) one has 1≤15, so M^3_{8,1} (hence also the hyperelliptic closed locus) is covered. This step is established.

### Step B — Tetragonal difference M^4_{8,1} \ M^3_{8,1}

Use the Hurwitz stack H_{4,8,1} of degree-4 covers with one marking and the proper map β'_1 : H^♢_{4,8,1} → M^4_{8,1}\M^3_{8,1}. SRC-0005 §4.5 gives the unpointed Casnati–Ekedahl splitting stratification of H_{4,8}:

(Ψ0) E=(3,4,4), F=(5,6); (Ψ1) E=(3,4,4), F=(4,7); (Ψ2) E=(3,3,5), F=(5,6);
(Σ3) E=(2,4,5), F=(4,7); (Z) E=(1,5,5), F=(2,9) (hyperelliptic).

SRC-0005 Lemma 4.9 shows A^*(H_{4,8}\β^{-1}(M^3_8)) is generated by CE classes, hence classes supported on M^4_8 are tautological on the unpointed open. The pointed genus-7 template of SRC-0002 §5.2 (affine-bundle presentations of CE strata over BAut(E)×BAut(F), evaluation conditions for markings, Prop. 4.2(1)(4)(5)(6)) is the intended extension: realize each pointed CE stratum of H_{4,8,1} as an open in a vector bundle / Grassmann configuration over a BGL-type base that has CKgP, then push forward by β'_1 (Prop. 4.2(2)).

GAP-B1: No published verification that every CE stratum of H_{4,8,1} admits a CKgP presentation for n=1.
GAP-B2: Surjectivity A^*((P E^vee)_1) → A^*(stratum) is not checked for the unbalanced strata (Σ3 and the bielliptic closed subset inside it).
GAP-B3: Proper pushforward controls supported Chow classes; CKgP of the image requires the domain CKgP plus Prop. 4.2(2), not merely A^*=R^* on the image.

### Step C — Pentagonal difference M^5_{8,1} \ M^4_{8,1}

SRC-0005 Lemma 5.6 (Schreyer) stratifies H_{5,8} by CE splitting types of E,F; Lemma 5.7 proves A^*(H_{5,8}\β^{-1}(M^4_8)) is generated by CE classes, so classes supported on M_8\M^4_8 are tautological unpointed. The general stratum is E=(3,3,3,3), F=(4,5,5,5,5); the only “bad” non-Ψ stratum outside β^{-1}(M^4_8) is Σ2 with E=(2,3,3,4), F=(4,4,5,5,6), handled by expected-codimension degeneracy of F.

To get CKgP (not only tautological Chow generation) for the pointed open of exact gonality 5, one must either (i) promote each CE stratum of H_{5,8,1} to a CKgP quotient presentation with one marking, or (ii) give a Mukai-type linear-section model for general genus-8 curves with one marked point (analogous to SRC-0002 §5.3 for genus 7, where M^♢_{7,n} embeds openly into a Grassmann bundle over OG(5,V)^n for n≤4).

GAP-C1: No published CKgP statement for H_{5,8,1} or for M^5_{8,1}\M^4_{8,1}.
GAP-C2: SRC-0005 proves A^*(M_8)=R^*(M_8) by excision of gonality strata; that is strictly weaker than CKgP of M_8, and does not upgrade to CKgP of M_{8,1}. SRC-0005 notes / packet notes: unpointed tautological Chow does not by itself imply CKgP.
GAP-C3: Even if A^*(M_{8,1})=R^*(M_{8,1}) were known, Lemma 4.3 needs CKgP to conclude that W_k H^k is algebraic; pure Tate of the single weight piece W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16} is weaker still and is not automatic from unpointed A^*=R^* alone.

### Step D — From CKgP of M_{8,1} to the degree-16 pure-weight input

Assume arguendo that Steps B–C close and M_{8,1} has CKgP. Then SRC-0002 Lemma 4.3 gives surjectivity of the cycle class map onto ⊕_k W_k H^k(M_{8,1}). In particular W_{16} H^{16}(M_{8,1}) is algebraic and pure Hodge–Tate. Passing to Borel–Moore / compact support with the usual weight and Tate-twist bookkeeping (duality between H^{BM}_* and H^*_c; pure weight −16 on BM degree 16 dual to pure weight 16 on compactly supported cohomology of degree 16, shifted by dim=3·8−3+1=22 when comparing to ordinary cohomology of M̄) yields that W_{-16} H^{BM}_{16}(M_{8,1}) is a direct sum of Q(8).

GAP-D1: The precise identification of Tate twists under BM duality and Gysin shifts must be written with dim M_{8,1}=22 and the weight convention of (6.1); this bookkeeping is standard but is not re-checked line-by-line here.
GAP-D2: Algebraicity of pure weight is stronger than needed for pure Tate, but without CKgP one does not obtain either statement from the available unpointed Chow computation.

## What is not claimed

- Completeness of CONJ-0001 (global H^{16}(M̄_{g,n})≅⊕ Q(−8)) is not claimed: other RED-0001 cases (M_{3,12}, M_{5,8}, M_{6,6}, M_{7,4}, M_{8,0}, M_{8,2}) remain.
- Chenevier–Lannes arithmetic prediction that weight-16 pure motives are Tate (SRC-0001) is orientation only; it is not used as evidence.
- No semisimplification of Galois representations is substituted for a Hodge-structure statement.
- No tautological intersection pairing on M̄_{8,1} is asserted to be perfect; no computational pairing is invoked.
- A^*(M_8)=R^*(M_8) (SRC-0005 Thm 1.2) is not upgraded to CKgP of M_8 or of M_{8,1}.

## Conclusion of this approach

The gonality-stratification route reduces the (8,1) pure-weight obstruction to CKgP of the pointed tetragonal and pentagonal differences. The trigonal closed locus is already known to have CKgP. The tetragonal and pentagonal pointed CKgP statements are open geometric gaps patterned on the genus-7 pointed work of SRC-0002 §5 and the unpointed genus-8 CE analysis of SRC-0005. Until GAP-B1–B3 and GAP-C1–C3 are closed, W_{-16} H^{BM}_{16}(M_{8,1}) is not discharged, and the degree-16 induction cannot absorb the (8,1) base case by this method.
assumptions: Coefficients Q; mixed Hodge structures / weight conventions as in SRC-0002.
All moduli objects are stacks M_{g,n}, M̄_{g,n}; coarse spaces are not substituted.
Maximal gonality of a smooth genus-8 curve is 5 (Brill–Noether).
Standard CKgP inheritance lemmas of SRC-0002 Proposition 4.2 / SRC-0004 §3.1 apply to the Hurwitz and gonality stacks once presentations are written.
No appeal is made to Chenevier–Lannes predictions, to l-adic semisimplifications, or to unproved perfectness of tautological pairings.
claims: For k=16 and n=1, Borel–Moore vanishing forces open pure-weight base cases only for g≤8; among these, g=8 is outside the published CKgP table of SRC-0002 (Table 1 ends at g=7).

The right-exact sequence (6.1) of SRC-0002 identifies the degree-16 compactified inductive input with W_{-16} H^{BM}_{16}(M_{g,n}); for (g,n)=(8,1) this pure-weight piece is not covered by THM-0005 / Proposition 4.5.
M^3_{8,1} has the CKgP and supports only tautological classes, by SRC-0004 Lemma 9.9 (n=1≤g+7=15).
If M_{8,1} had the CKgP, then SRC-0002 Lemma 4.3 would make every pure weight space W_k H^k(M_{8,1}) algebraic, hence pure Hodge–Tate in even degree k.
Unpointed A^*(M_8)=R^*(M_8) (SRC-0005 Theorem 1.2) does not imply CKgP of M_8 or of M_{8,1}, and does not by itself discharge W_{-16} H^{BM}_{16}(M_{8,1}).

The Casnati–Ekedahl / Schreyer stratifications of H_{4,8} and H_{5,8} supply the correct unpointed geometric skeleton for a pointed CKgP proof, but the pointed n=1 CKgP statements are not established in the supplied sources.
This attempt does not prove pure Tate for W_{-16} H^{BM}_{16}(M_{8,1}) and does not complete RED-0001 or CONJ-0001.
gap_markers: GAP-B1: CKgP not verified for CE strata of the pointed Hurwitz stack H_{4,8,1}.
GAP-B2: Surjectivity of Chow from the ambient projective-bundle configuration onto unbalanced pointed tetragonal strata (including bielliptic closed loci) is unchecked.
GAP-B3: Proper pushforward of tautological/CE classes does not automatically yield CKgP of the tetragonal image M^4_{8,1}\M^3_{8,1}.
GAP-C1: No CKgP for H_{5,8,1} or for the exact-gonality-5 open M^5_{8,1}\M^4_{8,1}.
GAP-C2: SRC-0005 tautological generation of A^*(M_8) does not upgrade to CKgP of M_8 or M_{8,1}.
GAP-C3: Even a hypothetical proof of A^*(M_{8,1})=R^*(M_{8,1}) without CKgP would not trigger Lemma 4.3.
GAP-D1: Explicit BM-duality / Gysin / Tate-twist bookkeeping for dim M_{8,1}=22 at weight −16 is not re-derived line-by-line in this attempt.
GAP-D2: Without closing B and C, the pure-weight input W_{-16} H^{BM}_{16}(M_{8,1}) remains open.
GAP-GLOBAL: Other RED-0001 cases (M_{3,12}, M_{5,8}, M_{6,6}, M_{7,4}, M_{8,0}, M_{8,2}) are out of scope of this single-case attempt; CONJ-0001 is not proved.
